en-US.description: 3D texture painting; an open-source, modern texture painting application, built in pure Rust
en-US.longDescription:
TextureCraft is a fast, open-source 3D texture painting workflow: paint PBR materials straight onto your models in layers with masks, bake mesh maps, drive smart materials from them and export textures for any engine. It runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux and FreeBSD, and in the browser via WebAssembly.

- Familiar: texture sets, a layer stack with per-channel blending, masks and generators, smart materials, the tool shelf, the 3D and 2D views.
- Fast: a tiled, copy-on-write texel engine on every CPU core and a wgpu viewport (Vulkan, Metal, DX12, WebGPU). Mesh maps bake on the GPU about 12x faster than on the CPU, and 8K texture sets stay responsive while you paint.
- Seamless: brush stamps live on the 3D surface, so strokes flow across UV seams, and the camera's visibility keeps paint off the back of your model.
- Open: glTF/GLB, FBX, COLLADA, USD, Alembic, OBJ, PLY and STL in; PNG, JPEG, TGA, TIFF, BMP, WEBP, EXR and HDR textures out at 8, 16 or 32 bits, with UDIM tiles; textured OBJ, GLB and USD mesh export.
- Agent-native: every menu item and tool is a command you can drive from the CLI, a JSON control channel or an MCP server.

en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- Little helper for AGENTS.md to prevent any application name leakage by @chasse20 in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/240
- Pass the Linux signing key to the release workflow by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/242
- Recover older projects with incompatible bake settings by @chasse20 in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/248
- UI: mode buttons at the right end of the top bar, tool controls scroll when they don't fit by @Rebornim in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/249
- Mark reimported projects as modified by @Agapenordev in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/271
- Bake mode: mesh map bakers list and per-map settings by @Rebornim in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/257
- UI: view layout and projection dropdowns in the top bar by @Rebornim in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/268
- Camera bookmarks: Ctrl+1…9 and a smooth glide by @Aalzard in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/260
- UI: draggable divider between the 3D and 2D views by @Rebornim in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/267
- UI: smart mask previews that show the mask by @Rebornim in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/283
- UI: fit the unsaved-changes dialog to its contents by @Rebornim in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/285
- Drop a shelf material on the texture set under the cursor by @Rebornim in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/290
- 256 bake settings edits only apply to the active texture set by @chasse20 in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/293
- Shelf hover preview: a big version of the thumbnail by @Rebornim in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/289
- Helpful PR review guidelines doc for reviewers by @chasse20 in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/299
- Copy the shared house rules into AGENTS.md by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/302
- Masks and content stacks run every neighbourhood filter by @Rebornim in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/298
New Contributors
- @Aalzard made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/260
- @FredApps made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/pull/302
Full Changelog: https://github.com/storytold/texturecraft/compare/v0.3.2...v0.4.0

zh-CN.description: 3D 纹理绘制；一个用纯 Rust 打造的开源现代纹理绘制应用
zh-CN.longDescription:
TextureCraft 是一套快速、开源的 3D 纹理绘制工作流：以图层和蒙版将 PBR 材质直接绘制到你的模型上，烘焙网格贴图，用它们驱动智能材质，并为任意引擎导出贴图。它可在 macOS、Windows、Linux 和 FreeBSD 上原生运行，也可通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行。

- 熟悉：纹理集、支持逐通道混合的图层堆栈、蒙版与生成器、智能材质、工具架，以及 3D 和 2D 视图。
- 快速：在每个 CPU 核心上运行的分块写时复制像素引擎，以及 wgpu 视口（Vulkan、Metal、DX12、WebGPU）。网格贴图在 GPU 上烘焙，速度约为 CPU 的 12 倍，绘制 8K 纹理集时依然流畅响应。
- 无缝：笔刷印花位于 3D 表面上，因此笔画可以跨越 UV 接缝，相机的可见性也会避免把颜料画到模型背面。
- 开放：支持导入 glTF/GLB、FBX、COLLADA、USD、Alembic、OBJ、PLY 和 STL；导出 PNG、JPEG、TGA、TIFF、BMP、WEBP、EXR 和 HDR 贴图，支持 8、16 或 32 位以及 UDIM 图块；还可导出带贴图的 OBJ、GLB 和 USD 网格。
- 智能体友好：每个菜单项和工具都是一条命令，可通过命令行、JSON 控制通道或 MCP 服务器调用。
